name: CometDEX
rootCause: The BLND-USDC liquidity pool of CometDEX (Comet AMM) on the Stellar network was exploited due to an accounting bug that allowed same-asset swaps (USDC→USDC), corrupting reserve calculations. The attacker used flash loans from a Blend pool and repeated the process about 36 times to extract excess funds, resulting in a loss of approximately $717,518.92 USDC. Funds were subsequently moved.

descriptions.text: The BLND-USDC liquidity pool of CometDEX (Comet AMM) on the Stellar network was exploited due to an accounting bug that allowed same-asset swaps (USDC→USDC), corrupting reserve calculations. The attacker used flash loans from a Blend pool and repeated the process about 36 times to extract excess funds, resulting in a loss of approximately $717,518.92 USDC. Funds were subsequently moved.

CometDEX suffered a $717K exploit on Stellar on 25 August 2026, when attackers drained pooled assets by repeatedly looping flash loans through a same-asset swap flaw in the AMM's share accounting logic. Broken share accounting in the Blend AMM contract allowed repeated same-asset swaps (USDC→USDC), corrupting reserve values and enabling attackers to systematically extract funds using flash loan loops. The contract failed to enforce exchange invariants or restrict swaps to different assets.
